name: create_grid
author: hprebar
title: Create grid system
description: Create a rectangular grid: X-axis grids are vertical lines at xStartPosition + i·xSpacing running from yExtentMin to yExtentMax; Y-axis grids are horizontal lines at yStartPosition + j·ySpacing running from xExtentMin to xExtentMax. Labels alphabetic (A, B, … Z, AA) or numeric (1, 2, …); names already used get a suffix. All lengths in mm.

xSpacing.description: Spacing between X-axis grids in mm

ySpacing.description: Spacing between Y-axis grids in mm

xStartPosition.description: X of the first vertical grid (mm)

yStartPosition.description: Y of the first horizontal grid (mm)

xExtentMin.description: Where horizontal grids start (mm); default = xStartPosition − 1000

xExtentMax.description: Where horizontal grids end (mm); default = last X grid + 1000

yExtentMin.description: Where vertical grids start (mm); default = yStartPosition − 1000

yExtentMax.description: Where vertical grids end (mm); default = last Y grid + 1000

elevation.description: Z of the grid lines in mm
